name: RDLs
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding weight in front.
Hinge at hips, pushing them back as you lower the weight.
Keep back flat and knees slightly bent.
Lower until you feel a stretch in hamstrings.
Drive hips forward to return to standing.
tips: Initiate the movement with hip extension
Keep weight close to legs throughout
safety: Start with light weight to learn the pattern
